item.title: STAT 482 - Regression Analysis - SIUe - Fall 2022
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: This is a problem set for STAT 482 - Regression Analysis at SIUe. These problem sets were given by Dr. Andrew Neath, a professor in the Department of Mathematics and Statistics at Southern Illinois University Edwardsville (SIUe) during the Fall 2022 semester. It covers topics in regression analysis.
